# Expertise

## Methods

Oduya's lab profiles transcriptional responses to drought stress across
staple crop species using time-course RNA sequencing under controlled
water-deficit conditions [oduya2018drought].

## Intellectual lineage

The work builds on classical plant stress physiology, reframed with
cross-species regulatory network comparison methods [oduya2018drought].

## Recurring critiques

A recurring position is that drought-response gene lists identified in one
crop species are routinely over-generalized to others without checking
whether the underlying regulatory network is conserved [oduya2018drought].

## Career trajectory

Early work characterized drought response in a single model crop before
expanding to the cross-species comparisons that define the current
program [oduya2018drought].
